2023-4289-4518-4785.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

4089-5011-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Glasspool Mimic.
When Glasspool Mimic dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 1.
Repeat.

339-677-2079-3899.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

144-5434-8095.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2 greater than the largest life total among your opponents.
144-5434-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, its first ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
Yarus' second ability triggers, returning Ashcloud Phoenix from your graveyard to the battlefield face down, and then turning it face up.
Ashcloud Phoenix's second ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to each player.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

323-1981-2415-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

5641-6854-7940.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters, Support Mission triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Support Mission triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Eldrazi Spawn.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.

2744-5086-7426.description:
Activate Triskelavus  by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.
2744-5086-7426.notes: You can sacrifice the Triskelavite tokens to their own abilities to deal infinite damage.

4659-5086-5183-6441-6996.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4659-5086-5183-6441-6996.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

573-3259-6628--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
573-3259-6628--85--106.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

4050-6115-7316.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ozox, adding {1}.
When Ozox dies, it and Rat King trigger.
Resolve the Ozox trigger, creating a legendary 2/1 Jumblebones creature token.
Resolve the Rat King trigger, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Jumblebones and the other creature token, adding {1}{B}.
When Jumblebones dies, it triggers, returning Ozox from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ozox by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

1170-1329-1482-4742.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard.
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

465-4605-5231-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Wormfang Drake and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Wormfang Drake.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2061-2120.easyPrerequisites:
Wanderwine Prophets does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one other merfolk.
2061-2120.notablePrerequisites: Wanderwine Prophets cannot be blocked by opponents.
2061-2120.description:
Declare Wanderwine Prophets as an attacker.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Wanderwine Prophets.
Wanderwine Prophets triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Merfolk token and take an extra turn after this one.
At the begining of your upkeep Extravagant Replication triggers creating a copy of a merfolk you control.
Repeat each turn.

4605-4681-6798-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {5}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Karmic Guide and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1621-7193.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Omni-Changeling.
1621-7193.description:
Cast Omni-Changeling by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Omni-Changeling enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Omni-Changeling. Choose to have Omni-Changeling enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

2231-4871-5220-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2231-4871-5220-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

539-5686-7031.description:
Cast Badgermole by paying its mana cost
When Badgermole enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Badgermole
When Badgermole dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Badgermole enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 3.

147-1465-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a permanent card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-1465-5231.description:
Cast Sevinne's Reclamation by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Sevinne's Reclamation.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Sevinne's Reclamation, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Sevinne's Reclamation copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

625-1978-2436.description:
Cause Marwyn to become an artifact using Ashnod's Transmogrant.
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Marwyn.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-3817-3991.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3234-3293-5413-5686.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5413-5686.description:
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-5413-5686.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

2034-2173-5220-6538.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Fear of Lost Teeth.
When Fear of Lost Teeth dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fear of Lost Teeth from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fear of Lost Teeth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Fear of Lost Teeth from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

3519-5295-5696.manaNeeded: {2}{G}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
3519-5295-5696.description:
Cast Jyoti from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Jyoti enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad creature token for each time you've cast Jyoti from the command zone this game.
Activate a Forest Dryad by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat steps 3 for each Forest Dryad token created in step 2.
Activate Food Chain by exiling Jyoti, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}{G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Choose to return Jyoti from exile to the command zone.
Activate Food Chain by exiling a Forest Dryad token, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Repeat step 8 for each remaining Forest Dryad token.
Repeat from step 1.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego exiling or tapping the Forest Dryads.

575-1718-5971.easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
575-1718-5971.description:
Activate Catalyst Elemental by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Catalyst Elemental dies, Yedora triggers, returning Catalyst Elemental from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Catalyst Elemental enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Catalyst Elemental by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Catalyst Elemental face-up.
Repeat.

1283-3750-4499-6300.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 8 life total this turn.
1283-3750-4499-6300.description:
At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, Megatron, Tyrant triggers, causing you to convert it into Megatron, Destructive Force and to add an amount of {C} equal to the life your opponents have lost this turn.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Megatron, Destructive Force and causing it to enter the battlefield as Megatron, Tyrant.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {5}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat during your next postcombat main phase.

4499-4893-5423.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Swashbuckler Extraordinaire.
When Swashbuckler Extraordinaire enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

586-997-5626-6112.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Fumulus's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing the Insect and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1247-2711-4613.notablePrerequisites: Selvala does not have summoning sickness and has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1247-2711-4613.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, causing each player to reveal the top card of their library, then causing you to add {G} and gain 1 life for each nonland card revealed this way, then causing each player to draw a card.
Activate Selvala using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
1247-2711-4613.notes: Additional mana may be needed to start the combo depending on how many nonland cards are revealed. It is also possible that each iteration may not cover its own mana cost, and therefore it is recommended to have additional mana available in case this happens and you have no extra mana from previous iterations.

225-3430-4499-5954.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-3430-4499-5954.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the Everywhere token.
Activate the Everywhere token by tapping it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Elbrus, the Binding Blade // Withengar Unbound

1495-4179-4613-5506.notablePrerequisites:
Withengar Unbound does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Withengar Unbound, or cannot prevent at least ten trample damage from Withengar Unbound.
Triskelion exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
1495-4179-4613-5506.description:
Cast Triumph of the Hordes by paying {2}{G}{G}, giving creatures you control +1/+1, trample and infect until end of turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Withengar Unbound, causing them to get at least ten poison counters.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.
Withengar Unbound triggers, putting thirteen +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Withengar Unbound using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, giving an opponent a poison counter.
Repeat step 5 until the opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.
Repeat from step 4.

215-729-2174-2404.notablePrerequisites:
Juniper Order Druid does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five other creatures.
215-729-2174-2404.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least eight {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Great Oak Guardian to your hand.
Cast Great Oak Guardian by paying {5}{G}.
When Great Oak Guardian enters, it triggers itself, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
If you control nine or more creatures, this combo will net infinite green mana, which you then may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Juniper Order Druid any number of times.

1284-2178-3500.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
1284-2178-3500.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1631-3497-4050-5220.notablePrerequisites: You have gained two or more life this turn.
1631-3497-4050-5220.description:
Cast Battalion Foot Soldier by paying {W}.
When Battalion Foot Soldier enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Battalion Foot Soldier, adding {W}.
When Battalion Foot Soldier dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Battalion Foot Soldier from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Batallion Foot Soldier trigger from step 2, causing you to search your library for Batallion Foot Soldier and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

719-1593-4508-5184-5299.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Treasure token.
"Pirate" chosen with Xenograft.
719-1593-4508-5184-5299.description:
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Furnace Celebration triggers, causing you to pay {2} to deal two damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Furnace Celebration triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to pay {2} to deal two damage to an opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

2410-4777-5129-5295.description:
Cast Silver Myr by paying {2}.
Silver Myr enters the battlefield, triggering Mirrorworks, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Silver Myr.
Activate both Silver Myr by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Myr Galvanizer by paying {3}.
Myr Galvanizer enters the battlefield, triggering Mirrorworks, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Myr Galvanizer.
Activate a Myr Galvanizer by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping all other Myr you control.
Activate both Silver Myr by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 6.

1261-1651.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping it and other artifact you control, untap Time Vault.
Activate Time Vault by tapping it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
